## ⭐⭐ Why this card is dispatchable today when it was barred yesterday — the ruling, verbatim

The maintainer ruled in this session:

> 没有卡的时候可以处理 p2/p3

⇒ NORTH-STAR clause 3 — 「产品仓还有开放的 P0/P1 时,任何车道不派 p2/p3 的**工具卡、契约卫生卡**」 — is ⛔ **not absolute**: it yields when the lane's queue has nothing else to dispatch. This card is a contract-hygiene card at p2 and was held on that clause for this seat's whole shift, with the bar re-measured each patrol (open **P0 4** · **P1 42** at the last count).

⚠️ **The seat's reading of the ruling, stated so it can be corrected cheaply**: with #19403 round 5 claimed in the same act, this card is the **only** remaining card in the lane's queue ⇒ 「没有卡」 is satisfied and it goes out in the same wave. ⛔ If the intent was 「only when the lane is wholly idle」, this dispatch is the thing to pull back — ⛔ not the ruling.

## ⛔ Start by MEASURING, not by converging — the card says so itself

The card's own 「⛔ Not measured」 section names the cheap thing first:

> Whether the three folds agree on **every** input or only on the inputs each one's pins cover. ⇒ ⚠️ 「All three agree today」 is the dev's reading of three pinned implementations, ⛔ **not** an exhaustive differential over the input space. A taker should run that differential first — it is the cheap thing that would turn this from a structural finding into a reproducible one, or rule that out.

⇒ **Run the differential before you converge anything.** Enumerate the input space of the fold (the permission bits: `allowRead`, `viewAllRecords`, `modifyAllRecords`, the per-verb grants, export) and evaluate all three implementations over it:

| where | symbol |
|:--|:--|
| `@objectstack/spec` | `objectPermissionGrants` (published by PR #18781, every cell pinned) |
| `@objectstack/plugin-security` | `PermissionEvaluator.checkObjectPermission` — **the enforcement door** |
| `@objectstack/lint` | `buildAccessMatrix` (`packages/lint/src/build-access-matrix.ts`) |

⭐ **The differential is the deliverable either way**, and it forks the rest:

- **All three agree on every input** ⇒ this is a pure structural convergence. Converge the two consumers onto the published helper, and the differential becomes the test that says they still agree.
- **They disagree anywhere** ⇒ ⛔ **STOP and report.** A disagreement at the enforcement door is a security-relevant defect, not a hygiene item, and it changes this card's grade and possibly its lane. ⛔ Do not 「fix」 it by making two of them match the third: which one is right is a ruling, ⛔ not a refactor.

⚠️ The fold as the card records it: read bypasses on `viewAllRecords || modifyAllRecords`; write bypasses on `modifyAllRecords` alone and **never** create; export requires the grant **and** read. Verify that against each implementation rather than trusting the card — ⭐ it is a reading with a timestamp like every other.

## ⛔ What this card is NOT

- ⛔ **Not a fix for a broken behaviour.** The card states 「All three agree today, and each is pinned on its own side. ⛔ Nothing is broken.」 The finding is that **one rule has three implementations**, and the repo's Route-&-surface-ownership rule 1 says that forks every future invariant.
- ⛔ **Not a merge with #18783.** The two cards have a recorded affinity and the filing seat deliberately did not merge them — 「that would widen #18783 before anyone has priced either half」. ⛔ Merging cards is triage's call and ⛔ an execution dev never does it. If you believe they are one card, say so in the report.
- ⛔ **Not a spec change.** The helper is already published. The move is to make the two consumers **ask** it. If you find you must change `packages/spec`, that is a clause-② hit and a different lane ⇒ ⛔ STOP and report rather than proceeding.

## ⭐ The precedent the card names

#17469 made the same 「one definition」 move for `isMultiValueField`. Read it before designing yours, and say in the PR body where you followed it and where you departed.

## Verification you owe

- The differential above, with its **input enumeration stated** and a **control** — a case where the three deliberately differ, or a demonstration that the enumeration is exhaustive over the declared bits rather than a sample.
- After convergence: an **ablation** per consumer — change the spec helper's answer for one cell and show **each** consumer's test goes red through it. ⛔ If a consumer stays green, it is not actually asking the helper. Mutation, run and restore inside **one** `ablation-replace.mjs` process; prove the restore with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The enforcement door is security-relevant: name every test file that covers `checkObjectPermission` and show the count before and after.

## Changeset

Measure it, ⛔ do not assume: check `private` and `files[]` for **both** `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/plugin-security`, and whether the changed bytes reach `dist`. ⛔ `skip-changeset` is only for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package.

## ⛔⛔ REPORTING CONTRACT

⛔ **You file NO cards. No `POST /issues`, at all.** Every out-of-scope finding carries **`class: a|b|c` + evidence** or a **`carrier:`** line; neither ⇒ PR `## Acceptance notes` prose, and 「承接者:无」 is legitimate. **class (a) must be reachable TODAY; class (c) must have a NAMED producer.** class (b) owes `Seam: spec:<key or symbol> → runtime:<callsite> | renderer:<component>` or `consumer: none`. Attach 3–5 dedupe words; ⛔ you do not dedupe — that is triage's. **The seat files everything.**

## Harness drift, hand-carried (⛔ the shared checkout is STALE — 8 files, 66/58, **106** commits behind)

认领带 `Clause-②:` 行才照抄进正文行首:`Check Changeset` 读正文不读卡;无则零写,⛔ 不自造。 ⇒ copy `Clause-②: no` verbatim to column 0 of the PR body.

⚠️ Exit 3 is PREREQUISITE NOT MET — ⛔ neither a pass nor a fail; name the prerequisite, and discharge it if you can. Capture every exit code **before** any pipe.

## Scratchpad

`/tmp/claude-0/issue-18785/` — per-issue. ⚠️ `/tmp/claude-0` is shared across parallel devs and same-named files collide silently; a sibling dev is working #19403 round 5 right now.
